subdivision.title: Subdivision surfaces
subdivision.about: Model a rough cage of quads and smooth it, the way Blender’s Subdivision modifier does (subd / subdivide).

photo-modeling.title: Model from photos
photo-modeling.about: Mark the same corners in two matched photos; SketchCraft works out where they are in 3D and builds the faces.

hierarchy-tags.title: Groups, hierarchy and tags
hierarchy-tags.about: Groups inside groups, a click that picks the whole house, hiding a whole chain, and tags with colors and solo.

environments.title: Environments
environments.about: Put a model in a ready-made setting (suburban lot, city block, park, desert, waterfront) in one click.

studio-render.title: Studio renders
studio-render.about: A seamless studio backdrop with softbox lights, and a photoreal render that sharpens while you watch.

subd-mode.title: SubD mode
subd-mode.about: Shape a smooth object by its cage: pick points, edges or faces, drag (the other side follows), add loops, extrude, crease.

first-model.title: Your first model
first-model.about: Draw a rectangle, pull it up, type exact sizes, and look around with the axis gizmo.

move-corner.title: Move a single corner
move-corner.about: With nothing selected, Move grabs the corner under the cursor; the faces around it fold to stay flat.

shelves-cut-list.title: Plugins: shelves and a cut list
shelves-cut-list.about: The Shelves plugin builds a bookcase from a few sizes; the Cut list plugin lists the boards and what to buy.

themes-layouts.title: Themes and layouts
themes-layouts.about: Classic (the SketchUp-like default) or SketchCraft’s own looks; docked or floating tool bars; your own icons.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.about: Model, Arch, Design and Previz arrange the tools for the job: walls and plans, solids, scenes and renders.
